dedupe_keys.name: sistema de informacion del anuario de aforos

description: Sistema de Información del Anuario de Aforos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The Information System of the Aforos Yearbook offers hydrological information (flows in rivers and pipelines and levels, volumes and evaporation in reservoirs) at the measuring points of the Official Network of Aforo Stations of the different Basin Bodies. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Capacity Yearbook Information System" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Its keywords include caudal, evaporación, embalse, río, conducción, evaporimétrica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.mapama.gob.es/es/atencion-al-ciudadano/aviso-legal.aspx). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
